summary: Executed backend+frontend regression testing for Iteration 58 on public preview URL. MOCKED deep_dispatch transport tests and live auth/registry/UI checks were run; one backend transport regression remains and one frontend control is missing.

critical.issue: On successful worker execution, transport_diagnostic is dropped from final response because result is overwritten with worker payload (line replacing result=value). This breaks retained stdout/stderr/exit provenance visibility after success.

minor.issue: CORS currently allows arbitrary origins (backend .env has CORS_ORIGINS='*'). Unlisted origin also receives allow-credentials=true and allow-origin echo; allowed preview origin is rewritten to cluster emergentcf host by platform edge for one request path.
Seed helper is create-only; existing admin password is never updated, so playbook expectation for update-on-change is not implemented.
No lockout authority/mechanism found in auth router/user_store (no failed-attempt counters or lockout path).

ui_bugs.issue: Expected explicit 'Open source' child control was not present in rendered row during live check, so single-invocation behavior for that child control could not be validated.

action_items: Fix deep_dispatch success-path payload merge so transport_diagnostic persists alongside worker payload on success.
Confirm intended CORS policy: if strict-origin policy is required with credentials, replace wildcard CORS_ORIGINS and align edge/backend origin handling.
Clarify/implement lockout policy authority (if required) rather than relying on ad-hoc test thresholds.
If Nexus spec requires explicit child CTA, add/restore visible 'Open source' control with a stable data-testid and validate single invocation.
critical_code_review_comments: deep_dispatch transport loop fixes mostly hold: nonzero/-1 refusal, budget recalculation, and timeout classification passed in isolated MOCKED tests.
Success payload currently loses transport diagnostic metadata due assignment overwrite after JSON parse; this is a root-cause-level regression risk for auditability.
History fidelity requirement still holds when a census card is opened: exactly 4 tabs and 13 metrics were present in live UI.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Use public URL from frontend/.env. For history checks, click a census card (data-testid prefix registry-census-open-) before asserting 4 tabs/13 metrics. Source catalogue row click/keyboard profile open-close-focus and async race checks are currently passing at 1920x800 and 390x844 with no horizontal overflow observed.
rca of the issue: RCA-1 deep_dispatch: execute_source writes transport_diagnostic before parsing output, then replaces result with parsed worker payload; this drops diagnostic fields in success responses. Repro: run test_i58_transport_drains_stdout_and_stderr_before_exit_status (MOCKED) and observe KeyError for missing transport_diagnostic. RCA-2 CORS observation: backend wildcard CORS_ORIGINS allows unlisted origins; edge can rewrite origin on allowed preview request to emergentcf cluster host. RCA-3 frontend control gap: expected explicit 'Open source' child CTA not rendered in tested source rows, preventing single-click invocation proof for that child action.
